verdict.rationale: Ente serves a live llms.txt at ente.com/llms.txt confirmed by two independent probes, giving an agent a fair entry point; however, docs-as-markdown and OpenAPI endpoints 404, so agent-oriented documentation beyond the single llms.txt file is thin. missing for 10: markdown-served docs pages, OpenAPI/agent-consumable API spec, broader agent-oriented doc structure beyond one root file.
